name: browser-use
headline: Session analytics tool for Codex and Claude
short_description: Session browser + Agents Analytics + Limits tracker for Codex CLI,  Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Factory Droid  & GitHub Copilot CLI. Search ALL past sessions, filter by folder·repo, resume instantly, see rate limits in real-time. Native macOS app.
author: jazzyalex

sections.overview:
Agent Sessions is a local-first macOS application that centralizes session management for multiple AI coding agents including Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Pi. It lets you search through all past sessions, filter by folder and repository, inspect transcripts, browse generated images, and instantly resume work from the command line. The app includes Agent Cockpit for monitoring active iTerm2 sessions in real-time, a Limits Widget for tracking Codex and Claude usage with run-out predictions, and local-only indexing designed to handle large session histories. All data stays on your Mac with no telemetry or remote uploads.
Search and filter across months of AI agent sessions from multiple tools in one interface
Resume interrupted coding sessions with one-click Terminal commands
Monitor Codex and Claude rate limits and usage in real-time with predictive alerts
Browse generated screenshots and visual outputs from past sessions
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jazzyalex/agent-sessions`
sections.usage:
```
Search all past [SESSION_TYPE] sessions (e.g., GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI) filtered by [FOLDER/REPO PATH] and [DATE RANGE]. Resume the most relevant session instantly. Show real-time rate limit status for [API_PROVIDER] (e.g., GitHub, Anthropic, OpenAI). If limits are near exhaustion, suggest immediate mitigation steps like switching to a different API key or reducing concurrent requests.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
